evidence.title: Another groundbreaking milestone achieved!
evidence.attribution: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (India) via LinkedIn
evidence.excerpt: STT GDC India reports that it marked the start of the named STT Navi Mumbai 2 and STT Navi Mumbai 3 data centres.

metadata.construction_wording_as_reported: We proudly marked the start of our STT Navi Mumbai 2 & STT Navi Mumbai 3 data centres
metadata.status_scope: The company-authored post explicitly marks the start of both named data centres. It supports one generic under_construction observation for each named project as of November 7, 2024, but no finer claim about site preparation, clearing, civil works, excavation, foundations, shell, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, occupancy, operation, or current load.
metadata.identity_scope: The post identifies exactly two named projects: STT Navi Mumbai 2 and STT Navi Mumbai 3. Schema version 1.0 permits one project per source document, so each project is stored in its own document with its own conservative locality-scoped campus target. The campus records are technical grouping containers only and do not assert a shared physical campus, separate physical campuses, parcels, buildings, phases, street addresses, or site boundaries.
metadata.locality_guardrail: The project names authoritatively supply Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India as locality-level identity context only. The source supplies no source-verifiable street address, parcel, point, footprint, boundary, coordinates, geometry, or unique-site proof.
metadata.comment_guardrail: All LinkedIn comments are excluded from factual evidence. In particular, a commenter-authored claim about 110+ MW, a three-data-centre campus, DC1 being operational with a customer, and the other two facilities starting simultaneously supplies no normalized capacity, campus identity, facility count, lifecycle, customer, role, timing, or corroboration.
